email.subject: First Notice of Loss – Riverside Manufacturing Co. Policy SBA-4471902
email.body:
Good morning,

Please accept this first notice of loss for Riverside Manufacturing Co. under policy SBA-4471902 issued by The Hartford.

Loss details:
- Insured: Riverside Manufacturing Co.
- Location: 2200 Foundry Road, Cleveland, OH 44115
- Contact: Karen Delgado, (216) 555-0173, kdelgado@riversidemfg.com
- Requested effective date of loss: 08/14/2025

A forklift struck a pallet rack in the west warehouse, causing visible damage to racking and several stored finished parts. No injuries have been reported at this time. Please advise the claim number, adjuster assignment, and any immediate documentation you need from the insured.

Thank you,
Megan Ross
Great Lakes Insurance Advisors
